answer: Trust arrives on foot in this design. Every epoch, verifier tokens wander from established agents along eight-hop random walks of the peer-grading graph, and each identity is paid in proportion to the tokens that land on it. A clone farm linked to honest agents by a few edges only catches walks crossing those edges, so every added clone splits the same trickle; each one needs its own real grading ties. Newcomers also wait behind a velvet rope: pay starts after a sonnet, fourteen straight epochs of peer-attested answers.
